page_title: NAP 0-3 ATA | Napoli v Atalanta 30/03/2024, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+5' That's all for today as the game is over.
90+3' The linesman raises his flag for offside before Ademola Lookman (Atalanta) heads on.
90' The fourth official shows 5 min. of added time.
90' Giovanni Di Lorenzo (Napoli) spurned a good chance! He gets a shot away from inside the penalty box, but it goes just over the bar.

88' 0 - 3 Goal! Matteo Ruggeri shows great vision to find Teun Koopmeiners (Atalanta) with a cheeky pass inside the box, and his first-time shot is precise and sails into the bottom right corner. 0:3.
85' Napoli quickly take a corner kick with a short pass.
85' Giovanni Di Lorenzo (Napoli) gets to the ball from the resulting corner and tries his luck with a shot, but one of the defenders steps in to block the effort.
85' A quickly taken corner by Napoli.
84' Luca Pairetto shows a yellow card to Giovanni Di Lorenzo (Napoli) for his blatant foul.
82' The referee demonstrates he won't tolerate this behaviour. Teun Koopmeiners (Atalanta) is given a yellow card.

81' Victor Osimhen (Napoli) runs onto the ball inside the box and smashes it towards the bottom left corner. It's a great effort but an even better save from Marco Carnesecchi, who tips the ball around the post.
79' Victor Osimhen (Napoli) gets on the end of a defence splitting pass inside the box and immediately directs a low shot towards the middle of the goal, but the Marco Carnesecchi makes a great save.
78' Ademola Lookman (Atalanta) has a great chance inside the six-yard box, shoots to the roof of the net, but Alex Meret pulls off an exquisite save to deny him.
76' Juan Jesus (Napoli) is challenged in the air near the penalty spot and is unable to control his header from the corner, sending it miles over the bar.
76' The linesman points to the corner flag, Napoli are going to take it.
75' Francesco Calzona has decided to introduce fresh legs, with Giovanni Simeone (Napoli) replacing Frank Anguissa.
75' Victor Osimhen (Napoli) unleashes a powerful shot towards goal, but it is bravely blocked by a self-sacrificing defender.

74' Aleksey Miranchuk (Atalanta) beats his marker and unleashes a thunderbolt of a shot from the edge of the box. Alex Meret sees the ball late but does well to stop it going into the bottom left corner.
73' Flag goes up against Victor Osimhen (Napoli) and the referee blows his whistle for offside.
72' Atalanta failed to take advantage of the corner as the opposition's defence was alert and averted the threat.
71' Problems for Gian Piero Gasperini as Giorgio Scalvini is not able to play anymore. His injury is too serious and Rafael Toloi (Atalanta) replaces him.
71' The game is interrupted now, Giorgio Scalvini (Atalanta) picks up a knock and the physio has to come on.
70' Mario Rui (Napoli) lifts the ball into the box from the corner, but one of the defending players gets there first to head it clear.
69' Giovanni Di Lorenzo (Napoli) sends a cross into the box, but the opposition's defence clears the ball to safety. The referee points to the corner flag. It's a corner to Napoli.
67' Francesco Calzona has decided to substitute Matteo Politano and he is replaced by Jesper Lindstrom (Napoli).
67' The substitution is prepared. Berat Djimsiti (Atalanta) joins the action as a substitute, replacing Sead Kolasinac.
67' Ademola Lookman (Atalanta) finds himself beyond the last defender, but the game is stopped by the referee after the linesman signals for offside.
67' The corner is swung in but Atalanta can’t take advantage as a defender sweeps the ball away.
66' One of the defenders reacts at the last minute to brilliantly block a pass from Hans Hateboer (Atalanta).
62' Cyril Ngonge (Napoli) gets on the end of a lofted pass near the penalty spot, but it's a poor header and drifts high over the bar.
61' The game has come to an end for Mario Pasalic. He has contributed as much as he could today. He will be replaced by the fresh legs of Teun Koopmeiners (Atalanta).
61' The referee stops play so that a substitution can be made and Gianluca Scamacca departs the field of play to be replaced by Ademola Lookman (Atalanta).
60' Gian Piero Gasperini is forced to make a change. Davide Zappacosta (Atalanta) is not able to carry on due to injury. He is replaced by Matteo Ruggeri.
60' Davide Zappacosta (Atalanta) is writhing in pain and can now receive medical treatment after the referee signals for the physio to come onto the pitch.
59' Atalanta have a chance to score from a corner kick, but the ball is cleared by a defender.
59' Hans Hateboer (Atalanta) tries to send a pass but it's blocked.
55' Giorgio Scalvini (Atalanta) makes a strong challenge and Luca Pairetto blows for a foul.
55' Piotr Zielinski (Napoli) squanders a golden opportunity after striking the ball onto the post of the goal!
54' This yellow card was deserved. The tackle by Sead Kolasinac (Atalanta) was quite harsh and Luca Pairetto didn't hesitate to show him a yellow card.
54' The corner kick from Davide Zappacosta (Atalanta) is headed out of the penalty area by one of the defenders.
53' Marten de Roon (Atalanta) has a shot blocked from inside the box.
52' Cyril Ngonge (Napoli) seems to be alright and is okay to carry on.
50' Cyril Ngonge (Napoli) is clearly asking for some medical attention with his painful gestures. The extent of his injury is yet to be discovered.
48' Rough tackle by Gianluca Scamacca (Atalanta). The referee blows his whistle for a foul.
46' Half-time substitution. Hamed Junior Traore (Napoli) is replaced by Piotr Zielinski.
46' Half-time substitution. Giacomo Raspadori will not participate anymore and Cyril Ngonge (Napoli) is coming on.
46' The second half gets underway.
45+3' The first half of today's match has just finished.
45+2' Amir Rrahmani (Napoli) fails to find any of his teammates inside the box as his pass is blocked.
45' 1 additional min. will be played.
45' 0 - 2 Goal! Aleksey Miranchuk tees up Gianluca Scamacca (Atalanta) on the edge of the box and he fires the ball into the bottom left corner. 0:2.
42' Aleksey Miranchuk (Atalanta) gives away a foul for a clumsy challenge. Referee Luca Pairetto saw the whole situation.
41' Giovanni Di Lorenzo (Napoli) is offside and the linesman raises his flag.
38' The referee gives a yellow card to Victor Osimhen (Napoli) for talking back. He must be careful for the remainder of the match.
36' The number of shots on goal at present is 3:1.
33' A good clearance by a defender means the corner comes to nothing for Atalanta.
32' Marten de Roon (Atalanta) covers his face with his hands after wasting a promising chance. He takes the rebound on the edge of the box but blazes the ball high over the crossbar.
32' Mario Pasalic (Atalanta) is put clear inside the box by a lofted pass. He only has the keeper to beat, but Alex Meret comes out bravely to save at his feet. Great goalkeeping skills!
29' Matteo Politano (Napoli) shoots inside the box, but is denied by a timely block.
26' 0 - 1 Goal! Aleksey Miranchuk (Atalanta) finishes from close range with an easy finish and he makes it 0:1. He was ably assisted there by Mario Pasalic.
22' Marten de Roon (Atalanta) finds space inside the box to shoot after collecting a short pass, but it's a wasted effort as it flies high over the bar.
21' Hans Hateboer (Atalanta) serves up a nice cross, but Alex Meret punches the ball away.
19' Victor Osimhen (Napoli) times his run too early and the linesman raises his flag for offside.
18' Victor Osimhen (Napoli) wins the ball near the penalty spot and unleashes a header low towards the middle of the goal, but Marco Carnesecchi is alert and denies him.
17' Giacomo Raspadori (Napoli) decides to take a short corner instead of crossing into the box.
17' Victor Osimhen (Napoli) tries to pass the ball into the penalty area but it's blocked.
16' Giacomo Raspadori (Napoli) steps up to take the corner, but the ball just sails in among the defenders.

16' Giovanni Di Lorenzo (Napoli) sends the ball into the box from the side of the pitch, but his cross is blocked. The ball goes behind for a corner. Napoli will have an opportunity to threaten the opposition's goal.
14' Hamed Junior Traore (Napoli) goes on a solo run, but he fails to create a chance as an opposition player blocks him.
13' A cross from Mario Rui (Napoli) fails to reach the box as the defence clears the ball away to safety.
11' Sead Kolasinac (Atalanta) fizzes over a cross which doesn't cause any problems.
10' Giacomo Raspadori (Napoli) whips a promising cross into the box, but the opposition's defence intercepts the ball.
9' The Napoli players keep the ball and are exchanging a combination of passes. They are waiting for gaps in the defence to open up.
6' Hamed Junior Traore (Napoli) commits a rough challenge and Luca Pairetto blows his whistle for a foul.
5' Frank Anguissa (Napoli) attempted to pick out a free teammate inside the box, but Marco Carnesecchi comes off the line to clear the ball away.
5' Davide Zappacosta (Atalanta) makes a rough challenge and Luca Pairetto blows his whistle for a foul.
3' Davide Zappacosta (Atalanta) steps up to take the corner. He launches the ball into the penalty area, but it only finds the head of an opposing player who clears the danger.

3' What a great touch by Aleksey Miranchuk (Atalanta)! He picks up a precise pass on the edge of the box and immediately unleashes a shot on goal. His effort, however, only rattles the right post. What an unlucky moment for him.
1' The first half of this match is about to start.
Atalanta will kick-off.
Luca Pairetto was nominated as the referee for this game.
